title: Design the Manifold
description: Create a compact, low-loss flow path that promotes even distribution through a constrained manifold envelope.
hints: Uniform-looking flow usually starts with a symmetric entrance region.
A compact manifold still needs room for the flow to turn smoothly.

showcase.fidelity_note: MVP uses a four-lane manifold packaging proxy but still has one solver outlet boundary. It does not yet calculate independent branch flow rates or a true four-outlet balance percentage.
